description:
Debug Network Faster & Smarter with Proxyman

Proxyman is a high-performance Windows app, which enables developers to capture, inspect, and manipulate HTTP/HTTPS requests/responses with ease.
✨ Features
- Split View: View two traffic panes side by side with separate filters.
- Workspace tabs: Open traffic in separate tabs, each with its own filters and selection.
- Workspace sign-in: Sign in with a six-digit code sent to your email.

⚡️ Improve
- MCP now supports more tools, including Compose, WebSocket inspection, Reverse Proxy, and DNS Spoofing.

🐞 Bugs
- Fixed: Map Remote now sends the correct Host and Origin headers for WebSocket connections.
